name: Humaans
summary: Humaans is an HRIS with absence tracking, timesheets and reporting on turnover, headcount and salary spend. Its Growth and Enterprise options each have a Talk to sales button and no published price. Its home page states SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certification.

facts.text: The home page states that the platform is GDPR compliant, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certified.

Enterprise adds SAML single sign-on, Okta and Entra ID integrations, unlimited custom permission roles, audit logs, webhooks and a dedicated sandbox, while Growth includes up to 2 custom permission roles.
The home page describes a REST API, webhooks and pre-built integrations.
